query:
-- Total por conta no item_despesa_importado para abril/26
SELECT cc.nome, SUM(idi.valor) as total
FROM item_despesa_importado idi
JOIN conta_custo cc ON idi.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE idi.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
